detail.title: Researching Evolutionary Explanations
detail.summary: Maintaining focus on the evolutionary biology topic. I am initiating a search for empirical research methods that differentiate between adaptation, byproduct, drift, and constraint, aiming to establish a foundation for the current project, evo-trait-explanation.

children.title: empirical methods distinguishing adaptation byproduct drift constraint evolution

detail.reason: This search will identify literature that specifically addresses how evolutionary biologists empirically differentiate between these four mechanisms, which is central to the project's question.
